multi_entity_note: Reseller agreement between i3 Integrative Creative Solutions, LLC and Bravatek Solutions, Inc.
processing_note: Referral Fees will be paid within thirty (30) days of the collection of receivables from the Registered Referral.

contract.document_name.rationale: The heading and preamble name the Reseller Agreement.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The preamble says the agreement is made and entered into the 7th day of April, 2017; April 17, 2017 are signature-block dates and 4/18/2017 is the filing date.

contract.effective_date.rationale: The preamble defines the Effective Date as the 7th day of April, 2017.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The term is stated only as 1 Year; no expiry date is given.

contract.governing_law.rationale: The agreement is governed by the laws of the Commonwealth of Virginia; the first Virginia is the reseller's state of organisation.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: The contract is renewable for a 1 year extension by amendment; '1 Year' in the header is the initial term.

contract.notice_period.rationale: Renewal is by amendment, so no notice to prevent renewal exists; the sixty (60) notice is for termination without cause.
